errors.invalid_name: Enter a name of up to 80 characters.
errors.not_set_up: Finish the first launch before doing this.
errors.database: The local database failed. Try again.
errors.team_has_agents: This team still has agents. Move or delete them first.
errors.invalid_agent: Check the fields: name and role up to 80 characters, description up to 500, instructions up to 10,000, and the model must be one from the list.
errors.invalid_message: Write a message of up to 4,000 characters.
errors.agent_has_activity: This agent has messages or runs in a room, so it can't be deleted.
errors.invalid_client_request_id: The request could not be identified. Send it again.
errors.agent_busy: That agent is still working on a request in this room.
errors.client_request_conflict: This request was already sent with different content. Send it again.
errors.invalid_provider: That provider does not use API keys.
errors.invalid_api_key: Paste the full key, without spaces, up to 512 characters.
errors.provider_not_configured: That provider has no saved key in this workspace.
errors.keychain_unavailable: Could not access the system keychain. Unlock it and try again.
errors.git_unavailable: Git is not installed or could not be run. Install Git and try again.
errors.not_a_repository: That folder is not a Git repository.
errors.repository_bare: Bare repositories are not supported. Pick a folder with a working copy.
errors.repository_is_worktree: That folder is a linked worktree. Pick the main folder of the repository.
errors.repository_without_commits: The repository has no commits yet. Make a first commit and try again.
errors.repository_with_submodules: Repositories with submodules are not supported yet.
errors.repository_already_registered: That repository is already registered in this workspace.
errors.repository_not_found: That repository is no longer registered.
errors.repository_in_use: Some tasks use this repository. Change or delete them first.
errors.repository_unavailable: The repository folder could not be read. Check that it still exists.
errors.invalid_base_ref: That branch does not exist in the repository.
errors.invalid_task: Enter a description of up to 10,000 characters.
errors.invalid_task_transition: The task can't move to that status from its current one.
errors.message_not_found: That message no longer exists in the room.
errors.storage_network: That folder is on a network drive. Use fixed local storage.
errors.storage_removable: That folder is on a removable or external drive. Use fixed local storage.
errors.storage_synced: That folder is synchronized by a cloud service (iCloud Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox or Google Drive). Use a folder outside it.
errors.storage_unknown: Meelting could not confirm that the folder is on fixed local storage.
errors.invalid_worktrees_root: Pick an existing folder outside your registered repositories.
errors.task_not_preparable: The task needs a repository, a base branch and an open status to prepare an environment.
errors.environment_exists: This task already has an environment.
errors.environment_not_found: That environment no longer exists or cannot be discarded.
errors.environment_failed: The environment could not be prepared. Nothing in your repository was changed.
errors.environment_still_exists: The environment's folder or its Git registration still exists, so it was not discarded.
errors.repository_moved: The repository folder no longer holds the registered repository. Register it again.
errors.git_too_old: Preparing environments needs Git 2.40 or later. Update Git and try again.
errors.process_isolation_unavailable: This system cannot guarantee that Git runs without starting other programs (for example when Meelting runs as administrator or root), so the environment was not read.
errors.filters_not_supported: This repository uses Git filters that run programs on checkout (for example Git LFS), which are not supported yet.
errors.worktree_path_conflict: Something already exists where the environment would be created. Nothing was changed.
errors.task_has_environment: Remove or discard the task's environment before deleting it.
errors.task_repository_locked: This task already had an environment, so its repository can no longer change.
errors.environment_identity_mismatch: The environment's folder, Git registration or branch no longer match what Meelting created, so it was kept.
errors.environment_has_changes: The environment has files that would be lost, so it was kept.
errors.environment_operation_in_progress: A Git operation is in progress in the environment, so it was kept.
errors.environment_remove_refused: Git refused to remove the environment, so it was kept.
errors.environment_check_refused: The environment could not be checked completely and safely, so it was kept. Nothing was changed.
errors.copy_too_large: The selected files add up to more than 50 MiB. Pick fewer files.
errors.copy_selection_expired: That selection is no longer valid. Pick the files again.
errors.secrets_not_confirmed: Confirm that you want to copy files that may hold secrets.
errors.environment_in_trash: This environment is in the trash. Restore it from the Trash to use it.
errors.environment_not_in_trash: This environment is not in the trash.
errors.environment_move_refused: Git could not move the environment folder. Nothing was changed.
errors.environment_branch_not_deleted: The environment was deleted, but Git could not delete its branch.
errors.data_folder_unavailable: Meelting could not open the data folder.
errors.autostart_unavailable: Meelting could not change the login item of this computer.
errors.environment_filters_apply: This repository uses Git filters that run programs (for example Git LFS), so its changes cannot be reviewed safely. Nothing was run.
errors.environment_config_unsafe: The Git configuration of this repository includes other files, changed during the review or asked Git to run a program, so the review was refused. Nothing was run.
errors.review_timeout: Git took too long to answer, so the review was stopped. Try again.
errors.review_stale: The environment changed since this review was made. Refresh the review.
errors.invalid_review_entry: That file is not part of the current review. Refresh the review.
errors.protected_file: This file may hold secrets, so its contents are not shown.
errors.diff_too_large: The changes in this file are too large to show.

newWorkspace.title: Create your workspace
newWorkspace.subtitle: give your virtual office a name

teams.preview: This is how it will look in your office

team.deleteBody: The empty team will be removed from your office and can't be brought back.

agent.name: Name
agent.localDetecting: Looking for models on your computer…
agent.localStopped: This runtime is not running. Start it and detect again.
agent.localNoModels: No models installed in this runtime. Install one and detect again.
agent.localUninstalled: This model is not installed on your computer. Choose one from the list so the agent can answer again.
agent.descriptionHint: What this agent does. Your team sees it.
agent.descriptionPlaceholder: E.g. Reviews PRs and reports findings by severity.
agent.instructionsHint: How it should work. Sent to the model on every task.
agent.instructionsPlaceholder: E.g. You are a code reviewer. Start from the diff, prioritize security and answer with a list of findings.
agent.teamSubtitle: The team this agent belongs to in your office.
agent.identitySubtitle: The name and role your team will see.
agent.engineSubtitle: The provider and model that will answer for this agent.
agent.deleteBody: The agent will leave your office and can't be brought back.
agent.modelRetired: This model is no longer in the catalog. Choose another one so the agent can answer again.

empty.title: Your office is ready
empty.body: Create your first team to start adding agents.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Choose what Meelting lets you know about.

environments.title: Environments
environments.description: Where Meelting prepares the Git worktrees of your tasks.

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the language of the app.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Follow the system or pick a fixed appearance.

uiScale.title: Interface size
uiScale.description: Make everything in the app smaller or larger.

loading.title: Transition effect
loading.description: Show a brief animation when entering or leaving a room and when switching workspaces.

worktrees.title: Worktree folder
worktrees.description: New environments are created here. Existing ones stay where they are; nothing is moved.

issues.network: This folder is on a network drive. Worktrees can only be prepared on fixed local storage.
issues.removable: This folder is on a removable or external drive. Worktrees can only be prepared on fixed local storage.
issues.synced: This folder is synchronized by a cloud service. Worktrees can only be prepared on fixed local storage.
issues.unknown: Meelting could not confirm that this folder is on fixed local storage, so it will not prepare worktrees here.

timeFormat.title: Time format
timeFormat.description: Show times with a 12-hour or 24-hour clock.

openAtLogin.title: Open at login
openAtLogin.description: Start Meelting when you sign in to your computer.

reduceMotion.title: Reduce motion
reduceMotion.description: Limit animations. Automatic follows your system setting.

runSucceeded.title: Run finished
runSucceeded.description: Notify when an agent finishes a run.

runFailed.title: Run failed
runFailed.description: Notify when an agent run fails.

dataFolder.title: Data folder
dataFolder.description: Where Meelting keeps its local database.

providerKeys.title: Provider keys
providerKeys.description: Keys are stored in your operating system keychain, never in Meelting files.

providers.title: AI providers
providers.description: Connect the models your agents use in the cloud and on this computer.

cloud.title: In the cloud
cloud.description: Each key is verified before it is saved and is stored in the system keychain, for this workspace only.

local.title: On this computer
local.description: Ollama and LM Studio need no key: Meelting looks for them at their usual address and they work offline.

outcome.offline: Could not verify because {provider} could not be reached. Check your internet connection. The key was not saved.
outcome.provider_busy: Could not verify because {provider} is not responding right now. The key was not saved; try again in a moment.

rejected.provider_auth_failed: {provider} rejected the key. Check that it is complete and active.
rejected.provider_billing: {provider} accepted the key, but the account has no balance or quota left.
rejected.model_unavailable: The key has no access to the {provider} models Meelting uses.

deleteDialog.title: Delete the {provider} key?
deleteDialog.body: Agents that use {provider} will stop replying in this workspace until you add another key. Their provider and model do not change.

empty.title: No rooms yet
empty.body: Create a room to bring your agents together.

form.title: New room
form.name: Room name
form.agentsHint: Optional. Agents can come from any team; you can also invite or remove them later.
form.noAgents: There are no agents in this workspace yet.

finish.title: End the call
finish.body: The call ends for everyone and replies in progress are cancelled. The room stays in the list, disabled, and its history is kept.

availability.connectionDetail: The last request to {provider} could not connect. Check your internet connection.

leaveDialog.title: Remove {name}?
leaveDialog.body: {name} will leave the room and any request in progress will be cancelled. Their messages stay in the history.

invite.title: Invite agents
invite.confirmBody: These agents will join the room: {names}.

agentRun.busy: {agent} is still working on a request.

preview.nobody: Nobody will reply: it will be saved as a message. Mention an agent with @ to ask them.
preview.ambiguous: Several agents match that name: you can pick one when sending.
preview.several: You mentioned several agents: you'll pick one when sending.
preview.conflict: The mention doesn't match the chosen agent: you can settle it when sending.

errors.rate_limited: {provider} is receiving too many requests. Try again in a moment.
errors.provider_unavailable_local: {provider} isn't running. Open it and try again.
errors.provider_not_configured: {provider} has no API key in this workspace.
errors.model_unavailable: This agent's model is no longer available at {provider}.
errors.provider_billing: {provider} reports a billing or quota problem.
errors.output_truncated: The agent's response was too long and was not saved.
errors.invalid_response: {provider} sent a response Meelting couldn't read.
errors.context_too_large: The agent's instructions and this request are too long for this model. Shorten the instructions or use another model.

choose.ambiguous: Several agents match that name. Who is it for?
choose.several: You mentioned several agents. For now, pick one:
choose.conflict: The chosen recipient and the mention don't match. Who is it for?

empty.title: No tasks yet
empty.body: Create a task to organize work and assign agents to it.

form.descriptionHint: The first assigned agent writes the title; until then the first line is used.
form.repositoryHint: Optional. A local Git repository registered in this workspace.
form.baseRefHint: Saving the task does not create anything in the repository.
form.agentsHint: Optional. Assigning agents does not start any work.

deleteDialog.title: Delete the task?
deleteDialog.body: The task and its agent assignments are deleted. Rooms, messages and repositories are not touched.

repositories.title: Repositories
repositories.hint: Local Git repositories you can link to tasks. Registering one never changes its files.

environment.title: Environment
environment.notPrepared: Not prepared yet. The environment starts from the last commit of {branch}; uncommitted changes in your repository are not copied.
environment.noBase: Choose a base branch to prepare an environment.
environment.closed: Reopen the task to prepare an environment.

errors.checkout_failed: Git could not create the worktree. Nothing in your repository was changed.
errors.verification_failed: The worktree was created but did not match what Meelting expected, so it is not used.
errors.preparation_interrupted: Meelting closed while preparing this environment.
errors.removal_interrupted: Meelting closed while removing this environment.

environment.missingHelp: The folder of this environment is no longer where Meelting created it. Restore it, or discard the environment once Git no longer lists it (for example after running git worktree prune in the repository yourself).
environment.failedHelp: Discard it to prepare a new one. Meelting only discards it when its folder and its Git registration are gone, and never deletes branches or commits.

removeDialog.title: Remove the environment?
removeDialog.body: Meelting will run git worktree remove on {path}. The folder is deleted only because it is clean; nothing is forced.
removeDialog.branchWithCommits: The branch {branch} is kept with its {count} commits that are not in the base branch.
removeDialog.blockedTitle: The environment cannot be removed yet
removeDialog.blockedBody: These files would be lost. Commit them, move them or delete them yourself, then try again. Copied files such as .env count too.
removeDialog.operation: A Git operation (merge, rebase, cherry-pick, revert, bisect or a lock) is in progress in this environment.

copy.title: Copy local files into the environment
copy.body: Only individual files that Git ignores or does not track are copied, keeping their path. Nothing is overwritten. Up to 10 MiB per file and 50 MiB in total.
copy.secretWarning: Some files look like they hold secrets (keys, tokens, .env). Once copied they are ordinary files in the environment folder: Meelting does not hide them, and future agents with tools could read them. Read isolation for agents will arrive with tool execution.
copy.secretConfirm: I understand and want to copy these files
copy.none: None of the selected files can be copied.

problems.tracked: Tracked by Git: it is already in the environment
problems.already_in_environment: Already exists in the environment; it is not overwritten

copy.copiedHint: These files stay in the environment and block its removal until you delete them.

environment.inTrashHelp: This environment is in the trash. Restore it from the Trash to keep working with it.

link.linkHint: Links this existing task to the room or message. Nothing is created.

files.title: Files
files.description: Working environments (worktrees) of this workspace's tasks. Environments sent to the trash are deleted completely after 30 days.

first.title: Register a repository
first.body: A local Git folder with commits.

second.title: Create a task
second.body: Pick the repository and the base branch.

third.title: Prepare the environment
third.body: An isolated worktree is created and shows up here.

trashDialog.title: Move {count} to the trash?
trashDialog.body: The folders, with their changes and local files, are moved to the trash. You can restore them for 30 days; after that they are deleted completely together with their branch.

trash.title: Trash
trash.description: Environments are deleted completely 30 days after entering the trash.

empty.title: No environment on the clock
empty.body: Each one has 30 days to come back. Restore whenever you like.

purgeDialog.title: Delete {count} permanently?
purgeDialog.body: This deletes the folder, uncommitted changes, local files (such as .env) and the branch with all its commits. It cannot be undone.

review.title: Changes
review.loading: Reading the changes of this environment…
review.empty: No changes yet. The environment has no commits, staged, unstaged or untracked files beyond its starting point.
review.unavailable: The environment is not ready, so its changes cannot be shown.
review.snapshotNote: This view shows what Git reported when it was last refreshed. Other tools can change the files at any time, so refresh to see the current state.
review.partial: This list is incomplete: the output was cut at a safe limit. Some files are not shown.
review.operationNotice: A Git operation (merge, rebase, cherry-pick, revert, bisect or a lock) is in progress in this environment. The list shows what Git reports now.
review.conflictHint: Conflicts are not shown as a diff. Resolve them in the environment.

folder.empty: The folder has no files to show.

diff.title: Diff
diff.select: Select a file to read its changes.
diff.binary: This is a binary file, so its contents are not shown.
diff.noChanges: Git reports no line changes for this file (for example a rename or a mode change).
diff.partial: The diff is incomplete: it was cut at a safe limit.
diff.lossy: Some bytes are not valid text and were replaced.
diff.protected: This file may hold secrets, so its contents are not shown.
diff.noNewline: No newline at end of file

drift.up_to_date: The base branch has not moved since this environment was prepared.
drift.moved: The base branch has moved since this environment was prepared. Nothing was updated.
drift.rewritten: The base branch was rewritten and no longer contains this environment's starting commit. Nothing was updated.
drift.unavailable: The base branch is not available, so the comparison could not be made.
